prompt: Add a sender-receiver interface {{interface}} with one data element {{element}} of a new application type {{app_type}} (percent, range 0 to 100). Give {{component}} a provide port {{port}} on it, and map {{app_type}} to {{implementation_type}} in {{mapping_set}}.
note: The component with the most ports; the first mapping set it lists, else the one with the most maps; the value-category implementation type that set maps most often. The names introduced take the first free numeric suffix.
